title: Is Prime
description: This function should return True if a number is prime. The loop boundary is wrong and misses checking the last possible factor.
instructions: Fix the `is_prime` function so it correctly identifies prime numbers.
expected_behavior: is_prime(7) → True, is_prime(9) → False, is_prime(2) → True.
hints: Check the upper bound of the range.
The square root boundary should be inclusive.
